coder_notes: Translational specimen-collection cohort study (phase NA); the only intervention is biological sampling, with patients receiving standard-of-care treatment outside the protocol, so no drug agents are listed. Glioblastoma is named in conditions and inclusion criteria within a multi-tumour cohort design -> basket_gbm_eligible; 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' -> historical terminology. PD-1/Trm are immune-cell markers recorded as exploratory correlative 'other'.
